visualCharacteristics: Closing band over a full-width background image: a white section title above a row of up to four figures, each with an icon, uppercase title and short text.
contentPattern: Optional image-only row (background), a heading row (title), then one row per figure: icon image, title paragraph, text paragraph.
usage: Use as a closing editorial band that summarises key points as icon figures over a background image.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any icon-feature summary band by adding a background image row, a heading row and one row per figure.
